build.prompt_version: Trump Diary — Weekly Thread Package Prompt v1

week.headline: The forty-seventh week of Trump’s second term did not hinge on a single order or shock.
week.summary: The forty-seventh week of Trump’s second term did not hinge on a single order or shock. It unfolded as a dense layering of moves that treated power as something to be extended wherever it met only friction, not firm resistance. Immigration, national security, regulation, media, and even the physical shape of the White House were all touched. The pattern was not improvisation. It was consolidation: existing tools used more boldly, limits tested more openly, and the costs of pushing back raised fo

week_summary_notes: This week is best understood as layered consolidation across multiple domains rather than as a single headline shock.
Immigration and inward-facing security power appear to be the strongest operational threads.
Information control matters not only through media pressure but through symbolic state presentation, including the White House as a site of personalization.
Administrative capture is present less as a fresh purge story than as the bold use of already-subordinated machinery.
The weakness of resistance is part of the week’s meaning: power advances where it encounters friction but not firm blockage.
The rewrite should avoid overloading abstract constitutional language when concrete operational threads explain the week more clearly.

rewrite_guidance.opening_focus: Open with the week’s defining pattern: not one dramatic rupture but a dense extension of power across immigration, domestic security, regulation, media, and symbolic state space, all enabled by insufficient resistance.
rewrite_guidance.closing_focus: Close on consolidation as method—existing tools used more openly, opposition made costlier, and even public symbolism drawn into the logic of personal rule and control.
continuity_emphasis_notes: Emphasize that immigration and security are not new eruptions but mature late-year instruments of domestic control.
Show administrative capture as enabling infrastructure behind the week’s many smaller moves.
Treat information control and leader symbolism as connective tissue that helps normalize and stage consolidation.
Mention resistance mainly to show its insufficiency and fragmentation, not to reframe the week as a resistance story.
Avoid dispersing the chapter into too many equal threads; keep a clear hierarchy led by coercive operational domains.
